tei:div.tei:p: (ga)༄༅// rje btsun sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi sgrub thabs dang rjes gnang bya tshul bzhugs so// gang gis bsten na 'jigs pa kun// myur du sel mdzad sgrol ma dang*// dbyer med bla ma la btud nas// de yi sgrub pa'i man ngag bshad// skyabs 'gro sems bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/ rang skad cig gis rje btsun sgrol mar gsal ba'i snying ga'i tām̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel 'khor dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drang*/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ na ma ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā re bh+yaḥ bla ma dang rje btsun ma la phyag bya/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas/ shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis mchod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs rgyun bshags lan gsum dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom/ badz+ra muḥs tshogs zhing gshegs/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma'i sdong po 'dab ma stong dang ldan pa'i lte bar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi sems nyid tām̐ yig ljang gu gyur pa las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ rang nyid rje btsun ma sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel sku mdog ljang sngon zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi/ g.yas mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya dang*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pa la'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin zhing*/ snyan g.yon pa'i thad kar kha gyes pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad brkyang zhing g.yon bskum pa/ zhal 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing spyan dkyus ring ba'i spyan gnyis dal bur gzigs pa/ dbu skra nag po ltag par bcings pa'i zar bu phrag pa g.yon par 'phyang ba/ lang tsho dar la bab cing lo bcu drug lon pa'i na tshod can rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan cing*/

dar sna tshogs kyi na bzas mdzes par bklubs pa zla ba'i 'od kyi rgyab yol can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i sku can la phrin las kyi sgrol ma nyi shu rtsa gcig gis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐/ dbus su pad zla la gnas pa'i tām̐ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes pa gong ltar spyan drangs mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i tām̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañca ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha sogs kyis mchod/ oṃ a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ sarba ta thā ga ta zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bor dbang bskur sku gang dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag med sprul sku'i cha lugs can gyis dbur brgyan pa la mtshan sngags re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i mchod pas mchod/ phyag 'tshal nyer gcig gis bstod/ bsdu na/ lha dang klu dbang grub pa'i cod pan gyi// rin chen 'od zer 'phro bar gang gi zhabs// kun tu gsal bas nyi ma'ang zil gnon pa// phongs pa kun skyob sgrol ma'i zhabs la 'dud// ces pas bstod/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar yi ge bcu pas bskor ba las/ las dang mthun pa'i 'od zer 'phros/ bdag dang sems can thams cad la khyab pas phrin las gang 'dod bsgrub par bsams la/ oṃ tā re tut+tā re tu re swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar mchod cing bstod/ bcom ldan 'das mas bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol zhes brjod la/ 'khor dang gdan rnams 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur nas rang la thim par bsams la chos dang mthun pa'i spyod lam ci bder bya'o// 'di'i rjes gnang byed par 'dod na gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i lte bar pad zla'i gdan la gtso mo dang 'khor rnams kyi tshom bu bkod mthar mchod pa dang gtor ma gcig bsham/

me tog la sogs pa mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len ltar bshams la mchod pa rnams/ oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da'i bar dang*/ ting shag dgrol zhing dharmā ra ṇi ta lan gsum brjod/ gong du bstan pa ltar bdag bskyed dang mdun bskyed yan lag bzhi rdzogs kyis bskyed/ mchod bstod rgyas par bya/ gtor ma 'bru gsum gyis bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la yi ge bcu pa la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te sogs btags pa lan gsum gyis 'bul/ oṃ ār+yā tā rā sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ lha dang lha min sogs kyis bstod/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad byas la 'dod don gsol ba btab/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu dang sems bskyed gsal btab cing chos bshad pas blo bcos la/ sgrol ma 'jigs pa kun sel gyi rjes gnang zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal phul/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// lhag pa'i lha yi ngo bo nyid// dpal ldan bla ma'i bka' drin gyis// bdag la rjes gnang stsal du gsol// lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ rgyun bshags byas la/ maṇ+ḍal gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo rje btsun ma sgrol mas bdag gi lus ngag yid gsum byin gyis rlobs shig mngon zhen chags sdang gi sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa dag nas/ lus ngag yid gsum sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin du mdzad du gsol zhes brjod/

de nas mdun gyi rje btsun ma'i thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas slob ma'i lus la phog pas rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po dang snod bcud thams cad sbyangs te/ de'i ngang nas slob ma sgrol ma 'khor bcas su bskyed/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab/ bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas dang po ta la nas rje btsun ma gtso 'khor gyi sku kha ba bu yug gi rnam par spyan drangs te/ slob ma'i ba spu'i bu ga nas thim par mos la ting shag dkrol zhing*/ ā we sha ya aḥ.āḥdzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes yang yang brjod/ slar yang bdag mdun gyi thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dbang lha spyan drangs pa la mchod cing gsol ba btab/ dbang bskur rgyas gdab pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya/ des rje btsun ma'i sku'i rjes gnang thob/ sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi bar chad thams cad zhi bar byas/ lus rje btsun ma'i skur byin gyis brlabs pa yin snyam du mos/ bla ma'i thugs ka'i 'od kyis rje btsun ma'i thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung zhal nas thon/ slob ma'i zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i pad zla la gnas pa'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor du/ dang pos 'khod gnyis pas dbyer med gsum pas brtan par mos la sngags kyi rjes zlos lan gsum bya/ slob mas me tog 'thor zhing*/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyis// bdag la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// zhes dang slob dpon gyis me tog slob ma'i mgor bzhag la/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams kyi rgyud la rje btsun ma'i sngags kyi byin rlabs ma lus pa 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod/ des rje btsun ma'i gsung gi rjes gnang thob ces sogs gong bzhin bsgyur la ngo sprad/

bdag mdun gnyis la gus 'dud byas pas thugs ka'i sa bon las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ khyad par du sangs rgyas kyi phrin las kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa'i lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa mkhyen pa'i ye shes thams cad phyag mtshan ut+pa la'i rnam par spyan drangs te 'od du zhu nas mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar thim/ de las kyang de 'dra ba byung nas slob ma'i snying gar thim par bsams la sku'i rjes gnang gi skabs ltar sngags dang rol mo bya/ des rje btsun ma'i thugs kyi rjes gnang thob sogs ngo sprad rjes/ gtso bos sogs dang maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs 'dra/ des jo bo rje la sgrol mas gnang ba'i rje btsun ma 'jigs pa kun sel phrin las kyi sgrol ma nyer gcig dang bcas pa'i rjes gnang gsan pa yin/ zhes brjod tshom bu la mchod bstod bzod par gsol ba sogs bya/ ye shes pa gshegs dam tshig pa rang la bsdu gnas gsum bsrung la bkra shis bya'o// spros pa la dga' na bum bskyed byas la dbang skur gyi dus dngos su dbang bskur/ dbur brgyan pa'i rjes su me tog 'thor zhing bkra shis byas kyang rung ngo*// 'di'i brgyud pa ni/ rje btsun ma/ jo bo rje/ 'brom ston/ po to ba/ sha ra ba/ 'chad kha ba/ se skyil bu ba/ ram pa lha sding ma ba/ sangs rgyas dbon/ slob dpon yon tan dpal/ mkhan chen bde ba dpal/ mkhan chen ka bzhi pa/ rin po che bsod nams grags pa/ rgyal sras thogs med/ 'gro mgon dpal ldan ye shes/ glang thang chos rje shes rab rdo rje/ nub dpal rgyal bzang po/ nam mkha' bzang po/ chos rje blo gros 'byung gnas/ rje btsun dkon mchog blo gros/ thams cad mkhyen pa 'bum rab 'byams pa rgyal ba blo gros/ de'i spyan sngar ji ltar thob pa bzhin brjed pas 'jigs nas shākya'i btsun pa ngag dbang brtan pas dpal e waṃ chos ldan du bris pa'o//

// ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
